select droi.return_order_id, droi.platform_order_id, droi.platform_name, droi.shop_name, droid.sku_no, 0 as refundNum, droi.order_fee, round(droi.order_fee * droi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, droi.cny_settle_amount, droi.status, droi.return_create_time from dmp_return_order_info droi inner join dmp_return_order_item droid on droi.id = droid.return_order_id
and droi.refund_id like concat('%',#{params.refundId},'%')
and droi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and droi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and droi.platform_name like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and droi.refund_status = #{params.refundStatus}
and to_char(droi.return_create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{params.returnCreateTime_begin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.return_create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{params.returnCreateTime_end},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.order_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(#{params.orderTime_begin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(droi.order_time,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(#{params.orderTime_end},'yyyy-MM-dd')
